findings.summary: Adding onInput={handleInput} alongside the existing onChange causes the parent onChange callback to fire twice per slider tick
findings.failure_scenario: User drags the range slider: React's synthetic onChange fires handleInput (via the wrapper), and onInput also fires handleInput directly. Both call onChange?.(value, e) on the parent callback. If the parent uses onChange to persist data (e.g., a debounced network save), each drag tick produces duplicate writes/requests.

findings.summary: getAlertsUrl call does not pass the interval parameter, unlike the deleted CreateAlertButton which used useChartInterval() to pass it
findings.failure_scenario: A chart is displayed at a 5-minute interval. User clicks the chart actions dropdown and selects 'Create Alert for' a metric. The alert URL is generated without the interval parameter, defaulting to 1h in getAlertsUrl (getInterval returns '1h' for undefined input). The resulting alert rule uses a 1h interval instead of matching the chart's 5m interval, causing the alert to evaluate at the wrong granularity.

findings.summary: Removed conditional merge of STATIC_SEMVER_TAGS into stringAttributes when SpanIndexedField.RELEASE is present in EAP span search, removing semver filter keys
findings.failure_scenario: A user searches EAP spans and the release field is available from the backend. Previously, STATIC_SEMVER_TAGS (release.build, release.package, release.version.*, etc.) were merged into the filter keys, providing autocomplete and filtering for semver sub-fields. With this merge removed, those filter keys are no longer suggested or accepted, so users cannot filter spans by release.build or release.package even though the span data contains those fields.
